title: Relationship
description: Records a directed relationship between two IFS entity objects.

id.description: Globally unique identifier for this relationship.

entityType.description: Entity category for this object, normally Relationship.

basedOn.description: Id of the object this object is derived from.

entityDocumentationUrl.description: URL for documentation about this entity.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this relationship record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this relationship record was last updated.

relationshipTypeId.description: ID of the RelationshipType defining this relationship's type, inverse type, and allowed source and target types.

type.description: Relationship name copied from the selected RelationshipType object's type field.

inverseType.description: Inverse relationship name copied from the selected RelationshipType object's inverseType field.

sourceId.description: ID of the source entity, such as Organization/1; its type must be allowed by the selected RelationshipType's sourceTypes.

targetId.description: ID of the target entity, such as Member/1; its type must be allowed by the selected RelationshipType's targetTypes.

startedAt.description: Calendar date when this relationship began.

endedAt.description: Optional calendar date when this relationship ended; must not precede startedAt.
